Package dayplanner

Class Time

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.Time
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Time>
public class Time extends Object implements Comparable<Time>
Represents a specific time including year, month, day, hour, and minute Used to define starting and ending times for activities.
